requirement: Case management for merchants: link every merchant case to the storefront, auto-fill the business account, route to the merchant support queue, and escalate if no response in 2 hours. Also build an LWC showing the storefront's last 5 cases on the storefront page.
hidden_intent: All five parts; 'response' = first agent email or comment.

expect.notes: Case.Storefront__c/Business_Account__c exist; Route_Merchant_to_Queue and Escalate_Case flows exist — reuse; 'no response' may need clarifying.
